title: Representation transfer for dilations: λ^{−m}η_*μ with ξ(a + λ·)
statement: Let P, m ∈ ℕ, a ∈ ℝ^P, λ > 0 and η := dilation a λ. Let X, X' ∈ 𝒟_m(ℝ^P) with X'(ω) = λ^{−m}X(ω') for all ω, ω' ∈ 𝒟^m(ℝ^P) with ω'(y) = ω(η(y)) for every y, let μ be any measure on ℝ^P (Borel σ-algebra) and ξ : ℝ^P → Λ_m(ℝ^P) (MultiVector P m) any map. If X(ω) = ∫ξ(x)(ω(x)) dμ(x) for every ω ∈ 𝒟^m(ℝ^P) (Bochner integrals, with value 0 for non-integrable integrands), then X'(ω) = ∫ξ(a + λy)(ω(y)) d(ofReal(λ^{−m})·η_*μ)(y) for every ω ∈ 𝒟^m(ℝ^P), where η_*μ = Measure.map (dilation a λ) μ.
lean_statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (a : Euclid P) (lam : ℝ), 0 < lam → ∀ (X X' : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) m) (μ : Measure (Euclid P)) (ξ : Euclid P → MultiVector P m), (∀ ω ω' : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) m, (∀ y : Euclid P, (ω' : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) m) y = (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) m) (dilation a lam y)) → X' ω = lam⁻¹ ^ m * X ω') → (∀ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) m, X ω = ∫ x, ξ x ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) m) x) ∂μ) → ∀ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) m, X' ω = ∫ y, ξ (a + lam • y) ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) m) y) ∂(ENNReal.ofReal (lam⁻¹ ^ m) • Measure.map (dilation a lam) μ)
